crew.name: QA acceptance
crew.purpose: A scratch Crew for acceptance runs. Do exactly what the message asks, run shell commands when asked, and reply with the result only.

cases.title: the test user can reach the server
the model answers
cases.message: Reply with exactly one word: pong

cases.title: a shell command runs
cases.message: Run the shell command `pwd` and tell me its exact output.

cases.title: a command works where folder rules hide a path (the dashboard bug)
cases.message: Run `ls db` and then `echo shell-ok`. Reply with the second command's output only.

cases.title: commands run as the person's own Linux account
cases.message: Run `id -un` and reply with its output only.

cases.title: the server's secrets file is not readable
cases.message: Run `cat /srv/*/.env 2>&1 | head -c 300` and reply with exactly what it printed.

cases.title: other people's folders are not listable
cases.message: Run `ls /srv/*/data/docs/_users 2>&1 | head -5` and reply with exactly what it printed.

cases.title: four chats ask the model at once, all answer, none rate limited
cases.message: Reply with exactly one word: ok

cases.title: a Brain note can be saved and found
token usage and limits are readable
